## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] New behavior is covered by a test.
- [ ] User-facing docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated.
- [ ] No runtime dependencies were added.
- [ ] Unsafe operations remain opt-in and documented.
- [ ] Managed and generated files are not edited by hand.
- [ ] No secrets, private repository content, or generated `dist/` output are included.
